highlights: Notes has a new, calmer layout for everyone: a centred reading column, Favorites, Inbox and Pages in the sidebar, and panels that open only when you need them.

items.text: New and renamed notes from teammates and agents show up in the sidebar, and links appear in the side panel right away.
Notes has a new, calmer layout for everyone: a centred reading column, Favorites, Inbox and Pages in the sidebar, and panels that open only when you need them.
Markdown you paste anywhere in a note turns into headings, lists and checkboxes.
Notes reopens the last note you had open, where you left off. Checkboxes and live tasks now look different at a glance.
Notes you open and leave without typing no longer pile up as empty Untitled notes.
Undo in a note now takes back only your own edits, never a teammate's or Claude's.
The welcome note keeps its content on every device instead of opening empty as Untitled.

highlights: Connect Claude and other AI assistants to Moduo with just a link: sign in, choose what they can reach, and disconnect them any time in Settings.

items.text: Connect Claude and other AI assistants to Moduo with just a link: sign in, choose what they can reach, and disconnect them any time in Settings.
Moduo has its own connector address for Claude and other AI apps, so Claude shows the Moduo logo. Your existing connections keep working.
Connecting Claude again offers to replace your earlier Claude connection, and Settings shows when each connected app was added.

highlights: Settings no longer asks for a password: you sign in to Moduo with the code we email you.
A page now shows the pages inside it once, in the list at its foot. Older links to those pages in the text tidy themselves away, and /page opens the new page.

items.text: Settings no longer asks for a password: you sign in to Moduo with the code we email you.
A page now shows the pages inside it once, in the list at its foot. Older links to those pages in the text tidy themselves away, and /page opens the new page.
On a shared computer, switching accounts or signing out now also clears the previous person's cached notes in browsers that can't list their stored data.
Security and reliability improvements.

highlights: A mistyped moduo.app address now shows a proper "Page not found" page instead of the home page.

items.text: A mistyped moduo.app address now shows a proper "Page not found" page instead of the home page.
Reliability improvements.

highlights: Task details keep their full-width labels when the right panel is 320 px wide; they narrow only below that.

items.text: Task details keep their full-width labels when the right panel is 320 px wide; they narrow only below that.
Reliability improvements.

highlights: The privacy policy now covers booking reminders, chat files and statuses, email when away, who has a note open, and what account deletion removes.

items.text: The privacy policy now covers booking reminders, chat files and statuses, email when away, who has a note open, and what account deletion removes.

highlights: After an update, Moduo tells you once what changed. Earlier releases are in Settings, under About, and on the changelog page of our website.

items.text: After an update, Moduo tells you once what changed. Earlier releases are in Settings, under About, and on the changelog page of our website.
A browser tab left open across an update now offers a reload, and never reloads on its own.

highlights: Desktop updates now download straight from Moduo's own servers.
The web app keeps working after an update, instead of showing errors until you reload.

items.text: Desktop updates now download straight from Moduo's own servers.
